query:
select jsonb_build_object(
 'inspected_at',now(),
 'product_count',(select count(*) from garimpa.product),
 'observations',(select count(*) from garimpa.price_observation),
 'publications',(select count(*) from garimpa.publication),
 'shortlinks',(select count(*) from garimpa.short_link),
 'foundation_exists',exists(select 1 from pg_roles where rolname='garimpa_public_runtime'),
 'schemas_accessible_to_app',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'usage',has_schema_privilege('garimpa_app',n.oid,'USAGE'),'create',has_schema_privilege('garimpa_app',n.oid,'CREATE')) order by n.nspname),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_namespace n where n.nspname not like 'pg_%' and n.nspname<>'information_schema'),
 'outside_relation_privileges',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',x.nspname,'relations',x.relations) order by x.nspname),'[]'::jsonb) from (select n.nspname,count(*) relations from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where c.relkind in('r','p','v','m','f') and n.nspname<>'garimpa' and n.nspname not like 'pg_%' and n.nspname<>'information_schema' and (has_table_privilege('garimpa_app',c.oid,'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,REFERENCES,TRIGGER') or has_any_column_privilege('garimpa_app',c.oid,'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,REFERENCES')) group by n.nspname) x)
) snapshot;
